# HexPiece 2.9.1: the Haki edition, part 1

The owner's request: "I want Conqueror's haki to be fucking crazy." Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the lightning was
rendered and checked, and the build's checks pass.

- **The Conqueror's release charges faster the higher your Conqueror mastery.** It took 8 seconds to fill at any level; now about
  6 s at mastery 250, 4 s at 500, and 2.5 s at 1000.
- **Once the Conqueror's Haki has awakened, its lightning sparks off you.** Black bolts with a red rim, the same 3D lightning as the
  release, leap off your body on most moves (Ryou's, the fighting styles', every fruit's), 2 arcs at first and up to 6 at high mastery,
  at most one burst every 8 ticks. Now and then they spark on their own, even standing still.
- **Draw a sword as a Conqueror and lightning explodes off the blade**, some of it grounding.
- **The full release at high mastery is far more destructive:** about 7 to 10 enormous bolts at first, rising steeply to about 26 at
  mastery 1000, everywhere, up and down. The ones that come down tear fissures, and past half mastery every fifth fissure also blows a
  crater (up to 4.5 blocks of radius at 1000). The ground grows back as before.
- Kept light: every burst is one small message; each client builds the arcs itself, under the lightning's existing cap.
